artBrief: **Pixel fine art / art nouveau.** A luminous open book within a flowing botanical arch; theatrical golden light suggests a grand storytelling stage. No embedded count or text.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Pixel fine art / art nouveau. A luminous open book within a flowing botanical arch; theatrical golden light suggests a grand storytelling stage. No embedded count or text. Large open ivory book on a small stage under a flowing art-nouveau botanical arch. Gold and forest green, strong symmetrical theatrical composition, graceful leaf shapes not tiny filigree.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
